group.name: Amazon
group.description: Amazon is an e-commerce retailer formed originally to provide consumers with products in two segments. It offers users merchandise and content purchased for resale from vendors and those offered by third-party sellers. Operating in North American and International markets, Amazon provides its services through websites such as amazon.com and amazon.ca. It also enables authors, musicians, filmmakers, app developers, and others to publish and sell content via its branded websites.
